description: This Java source file defines a class 'UnicodeOrgEmojiTestDataParser' that parses emoji test data files, extracting emoji metadata such as group, subgroup, description, tags, and Unicode escape sequences, and converts them into EmojiData objects.

classes.name: UnicodeOrgEmojiTestDataParser
classes.description: A utility class for parsing Unicode emoji test data files, extracting emoji metadata, and converting Unicode code points to escape sequences.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Reads a test data file containing emoji information, parses each line to extract emoji metadata, and returns a list of EmojiData objects.

methods.name: convertToEscapeCodes
methods.description: Converts a string of hexadecimal Unicode code points into a string of corresponding characters.
